incoming.name: London Bridge
incoming.excerpt: Rennie's bridge was constructed from Dartmoor granite, with a length of 928 feet (283 m) and a width of 49 feet (15 m).

incoming.name: Royal Marines
incoming.excerpt: Much of the basic training is carried out on the rugged terrain of Dartmoor and Woodbury common with a significant proportion taking place at night.
